summary: An Anthropic employee describes using Claude's Artifacts feature to have Claude diagram and explain its work while using Claude Code, a collaboration between the Labs and Claude Code teams.

practices.reason: Suggests prompting Claude to use Artifacts to diagram its own work as a way to surface its reasoning, but this is a personal anecdote with no stated gain or method detail.
practices.quote: try asking it to diagram its work next time you're working with it
